answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one prism weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The thread report exposes the merge explicitly at each juniper. Because of that, someone who spins up 95 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 22 times the capital for one share. A farm of 628 identities would post 4734 proofs and burn roughly 43 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
